answer: Each identity is minted by sacrificing a relic: a token bound to one physical object's measured fingerprint, listed in a public lagoon registry that marks the entry spent at redemption. Redemption also burns an ember of compute signed into the same record, so a fingerprint cannot be replayed afterward. Cloning means acquiring N distinct physical objects, capturing each fingerprint honestly, and forfeiting every token once used, so hardware, shipping and burn cost make each fake identity dearer than the last.
